AI Video Maker from Photo — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release: Instantly turn uploaded photos into slideshow-style MP4 videos with transitions and music, no editing skills needed.
- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC uploads up to 200MB; automated cloud rendering with ready-to-download results in under a minute.
- Simple onboarding with automatic token/session setup; 100 free credits for new users.
- All key actions (upload, edit, export, check credits or status) handled via intuitive prompts or file uploads.
- Session-based workflow lets you preview, refine, and export video projects, with detailed error handling and clear user guidance.
